description: The Kubernetes Objects Receiver collects (pull/watch) objects from the Kubernetes API server.

feature_gates.description: When enabled, the receiver collects objects via a shared informer factory (List+Watch backed by an in-memory cache) instead of the legacy per-object pull/watch observers. Pull mode reads from the informer cache; watch mode uses informer event handlers with automatic relist/reconnect. The `pull` RBAC now also requires the `watch` verb, `resource_version` is ignored, and `exclude_watch_type: [BOOKMARK, ERROR]` is a no-op.

name: k8sobjectsreceiver
